name: esquerrapp-rules-tests
description: Dev-only test suite for EsquerrApp: the shard router, the security rules and the Cloud Functions. Self-contained (does not touch the app's root package.json). The rules and functions suites need the Firebase Emulator Suite (Java) to actually run.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.test:unit: mocha shard.test.js router.test.js utils.test.js navigation.test.js availability.test.js context.test.js readiness.test.js quota.test.js readiness-engine.test.js layout.test.js calendar.test.js calendar-render.test.js session-load.test.js seed-add-team.test.js seed-multi-team.test.js archive.test.js training.test.js reminders.test.js cat-badge.test.js kits.test.js tactic-boards.test.js ro-playback.test.js pen-space.test.js board-geom.test.js board-state.test.js board3d.test.js board3d-camera.test.js ball-spin.test.js board3d-gate.test.js board3d-menu.test.js board-window.test.js frames.test.js overlay-align.test.js object-scale.test.js board-markings-render.test.js pitch-resize.test.js board-authors.test.js fills.test.js fills-source.test.js push-send.test.js push-nav.test.js injuries.test.js staff-roles.test.js match-legs.test.js match-notes.test.js match-notes-render.test.js match-lineup.test.js fcf.test.js fcf-app.test.js fcf-fixtures.test.js fcf-discipline.test.js fcf-tabs-render.test.js fcf-acta.test.js fcf-referees.test.js fcf-referee-render.test.js version-check.test.js push-guard.test.js match-avail-reminder.test.js material.test.js plantilla.test.js partit.test.js convocatoria.test.js inici.test.js medical.test.js profile-pic.test.js paper-palette.test.js registrations.test.js std-select.test.js training-delete.test.js plantilla-charts.test.js weather.test.js suite-registry.test.js --exit
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project=demo-esquerrapp "mocha functions.test.js wipe.test.js teams.test.js templates.test.js club-kits.test.js --timeout 120000 --exit"
scripts.test:3d: mocha board3d.test.js board3d-camera.test.js ball-spin.test.js board3d-gate.test.js board3d-menu.test.js board-window.test.js overlay-align.test.js --exit
scripts.test:geom: mocha board-geom.test.js board-state.test.js board3d.test.js board3d-camera.test.js board-markings-render.test.js pitch-resize.test.js --exit
scripts.test:fcf: mocha fcf.test.js fcf-app.test.js fcf-fixtures.test.js fcf-discipline.test.js fcf-tabs-render.test.js --exit
